process_area.title: Job Architecture, Pay Structure & Market Benchmarking

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, HR Business Partners, Hiring Managers, Master Data (links to VS-29)
fields.Trigger: New role creation; role change; annual job-architecture refresh

workflows.name: Job Analysis, Documentation & Job Description Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "accountabilities, decision rights, scope" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "document the standardized job description" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "review cadence, and change governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-535 (ensure controlled execution — Job Architecture, Pay Structure & Market Benchmarking (PA-102.1).)
- operational: annual refresh; operational: templates and governance
Pain Points / Risks: - **Job-creep risk**: Outdated descriptions cause wrong grading/pay; mitigated by annual refresh
- **Inconsistency risk**: Non-standard descriptions break benchmarking; mitigated by templates and governance
System Touchpoints: - HRIS job master (links to VS-29.2); recruitment (links to VS-19.1); payroll (links to VS-19.2)

steps.activity: C&B Manager conduct job analysis with hiring managers: capture purpose, key accountabilities, decision rights, scope (people/budget/revenue), required competencies, qualifications, and working conditions (store/DC/HQ, shift)

C&B Manager document the standardized job description (job code, title, family, level, FLSA/exempt status, physical/safety requirements); store in the HR master (links to VS-29.2) and link to recruitment (links to VS-19.1) and payroll (links to VS-19.2)
C&B Manager maintain job-description version control, periodic review cadence, and change governance; retire obsolete jobs and update incumbents/payroll

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, HRBP, CHRO, Executives, Job-evaluation committee

workflows.name: Job Evaluation, Grading & Job Architecture (Career Framework) Maintenance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "C&B Manager evaluate each job against the job-evaluation methodology" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "review borderline/contested grades for consistency and equity" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "update HR master" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-535 (ensure controlled execution — Job Architecture, Pay Structure & Market Benchmarking (PA-102.1).)
- operational: methodology and committee review; operational: annual refresh
Pain Points / Risks: - **Grade-inflation risk**: Inconsistent grading inflates pay cost and creates inequity; mitigated by methodology and committee review
- **Framework-staleness risk**: Outdated framework blocks career mobility; mitigated by annual refresh
System Touchpoints: - Job-evaluation tool; HRIS (links to VS-29.2); career/succession (links to VS-19.1)

steps.activity: C&B Manager evaluate each job against the job-evaluation methodology (e.g., point-factor: know-how, problem-solving, accountability, scope) and assign a grade/band; build/maintain the career framework (job family, levels, progression criteria)
Job-evaluation committee (HR + business + finance) review borderline/contested grades for consistency and equity; approve the architecture and grade assignments
C&B Manager publish the career framework, map incumbents to grades, and link to succession/development (links to VS-19.1/VS-19.4) and pay structure (W3307); update HR master (links to VS-29.2)

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, CHRO, CFO, FP&A (links to VS-17.4), Payroll (links to VS-19.2)

workflows.name: Annual Salary Structure Design, Range Setting & Range Penetration

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "review structure cost impact, affordability vs labor-budget" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-monitor of "monitor range penetration and compliance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-535 (ensure controlled execution — Job Architecture, Pay Structure & Market Benchmarking (PA-102.1).)
- operational: cost modeling (W3327) and CFO review; operational: market benchmarking (W3308)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unaffordable-structure risk**: Over-positioned structure breaches labor budget; mitigated by cost modeling (W3327) and CFO review
- **Uncompetitive-structure risk**: Under-positioned structure loses talent; mitigated by market benchmarking (W3308)
System Touchpoints: - Compensation planning module; HRIS/payroll (links to VS-19.2); FP&A (links to VS-17.4)

steps.activity: C&B Manager designs the annual salary structure: per grade, minimum / midpoint / maximum (range spread typically 30–50%), informed by market data (W3308), pay positioning (e.g., 50th/75th percentile), internal equity, and budget (W3327)

CHRO/CFO review structure cost impact, affordability vs labor-budget (links to VS-33.1), and market competitiveness; approve structure and effective date; set range-penetration targets by grade/tenure
C&B Manager loads the structure into HRIS/payroll (links to VS-19.2), publish to HRBP/managers, and monitor range penetration and compliance (W3311)

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, Survey providers, CHRO, Strategic Planning (links to VS-33.3)
fields.Trigger: Annual survey cycle; ad-hoc market intelligence

workflows.name: Market Compensation Benchmarking Survey Participation & Pay Positioning

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "C&B Manager select compensation surveys" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-analyze of "analyze survey cuts" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-535 (ensure controlled execution — Job Architecture, Pay Structure & Market Benchmarking (PA-102.1).)
- operational: disciplined matching; operational: license controls (links to VS-91)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Match-error risk**: Poor job-matching produces misleading market data; mitigated by disciplined matching
- **Data-license risk**: Improper survey-data use breaches license/privacy; mitigated by license controls (links to VS-91)
System Touchpoints: - Benchmarking/survey tool; compensation planning (links to VS-102); analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: C&B Manager select compensation surveys (Philippine retail/industry), match BuildRight jobs to survey benchmark jobs using job descriptions (W3305), and submit anonymized pay data per survey methodology

C&B Manager analyze survey cuts (base, TCC, short-term incentive, benefits) by grade/family; determine BuildRight's market position (percentile) and gaps; recommend pay positioning and hot-skill premiums
C&B Manager feed market data into the salary structure (W3307) and merit/budget planning (W3327); brief executives and retain survey data under license/privacy (links to VS-91)

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, Legal (links to VS-100), CHRO, Internal Audit (links to VS-21.1), Data Privacy (links to VS-91)

workflows.name: Pay Equity, Equal-Pay-for-Equal-Work Analysis & Gender/Wage-Gap Remediation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-identify of "identify unexplained pay gaps by grade/job" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "review flagged gaps for root cause" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-monitor of "monitor remediation outcomes, report equity metrics to executives and audit" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-535 (ensure controlled execution — Job Architecture, Pay Structure & Market Benchmarking (PA-102.1).)
- operational: annual analysis and remediation; operational: privacy controls (links to VS-91)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Legal-exposure risk**: Unremediated pay gaps create DOLE/NLRC and reputational risk (links to VS-84/VS-100); mitigated by annual analysis and remediation
- **Privacy risk**: Sensitive pay/demographic data mishandled; mitigated by privacy controls (links to VS-91)
System Touchpoints: - Pay-equity analytics (links to VS-28.1/VS-103.3); payroll (links to VS-19.2); audit (links to VS-21.1)

steps.activity: C&B Manager conduct pay-equity analysis: regression of pay on legitimate pay factors (grade, tenure, performance, location) controlling for gender/other protected status; identify unexplained pay gaps by grade/job

C&B Manager/Legal review flagged gaps for root cause (historical, hire-in, compression); design remediation (adjustments within budget W3327), assess legal exposure (Labor Code, links to VS-84/VS-100), and execute adjustments via payroll (links to VS-19.2)
C&B Manager monitor remediation outcomes, report equity metrics to executives and audit (links to VS-21.1), and maintain analysis under privacy/privilege (links to VS-91/VS-100)

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, Payroll (links to VS-19.2), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Legal (links to VS-100)
fields.Trigger: Regional wage order (DOLE/RTWPB); annual structure refresh

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitor regional minimum-wage orders" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-update of "update pay by location to comply with regional minimums and reflect…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report to Legal/CHRO" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-122 (ensure pay equity & statutory benefits compliance.)
- operational: monitoring and audit; operational: trigger-based process
Pain Points / Risks: - **Non-compliance risk**: Paying below regional minimum triggers DOLE liability (links to VS-84); mitigated by monitoring and audit
- **Wage-order-lag risk**: Delayed update creates underpayment and back-pay; mitigated by trigger-based process
System Touchpoints: - Compensation planning; payroll (links to VS-19.2); LGU compliance (links to VS-76)

steps.activity: C&B Manager monitor regional minimum-wage orders (DOLE/RTWPB) across BuildRight's regions (NCR, CALABARZON, Central Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao) and LGU compliance (links to VS-76); assess impact on pay structure

C&B Manager set geographic differentials and update pay by location to comply with regional minimums and reflect cost-of-living/labor-market; load changes into payroll (links to VS-19.2) with effective dates
C&B Manager audit compliance (all employees ≥ applicable regional minimum), manage shift/night/holiday differentials per Labor Code (links to VS-19.2 W1416), and report to Legal/CHRO

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, Managers, HRBP, Payroll (links to VS-19.2), CHRO
fields.Trigger: Annual merit cycle; promotion; hire-in; off-cycle

workflows.name: Pay Range Administration, Promotion/Merit Increase & Range-Outlier Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validate range penetration and flag range outliers" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System rule-based auto-approval of "approved changes via payroll" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-535 (ensure controlled execution — Job Architecture, Pay Structure & Market Benchmarking (PA-102.1).)
- operational: validation and remediation; operational: guidelines and calibration
Pain Points / Risks: - **Range-violation risk**: Pay below min (legal/retention risk) or above max (cost/inequity); mitigated by validation and remediation
- **Merit-inequity risk**: Inconsistent merit awards create disparity; mitigated by guidelines and calibration
System Touchpoints: - Compensation planning; payroll (links to VS-19.2); approval workflow (links to VS-27/VS-36); HRIS (links to VS-29.2)

steps.activity: C&B Manager run the annual merit cycle: guidelines (budget % per W3327, performance linkage to VS-19.4), manager tooling to recommend increases within range, and approval workflow per authority matrix (links to VS-36)

Managers/HRBP administer promotions, hire-in offers (links to VS-19.1), and off-cycle adjustments within approved structure; C&B Manager validate range penetration and flag range outliers (below min / above max) for remediation
C&B Manager/Payroll execute approved changes via payroll (links to VS-19.2), update HR master, and report merit/promotion outcomes and outlier remediation to CHRO/CFO

fields.Participants: CHRO, C&B Manager, Legal (links to VS-100/VS-36), CFO, Compensation Committee, Board (links to VS-36.1)
fields.Trigger: Annual policy review; executive pay cycle; board governance (links to VS-36)

workflows.name: Compensation Policy, Governance & Executive Pay Review

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "review and update annually for legal and market change" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-generate of "prepare executive pay review" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report compensation governance outcomes, policy compliance, and pay-equity" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-122 (ensure pay equity & statutory benefits compliance.)
- operational: committee/board oversight; operational: annual review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Governance-gap risk**: Weak executive-pay governance creates reputational/SEC risk; mitigated by committee/board oversight
- **Policy-staleness risk**: Outdated policy creates inconsistency and non-compliance; mitigated by annual review
System Touchpoints: - Compensation planning; governance (links to VS-36); legal/matter (links to VS-100); audit (links to VS-21.1)

steps.activity: C&B Manager/CHRO maintain the compensation policy (pay philosophy, positioning, merit/promotion/overtime/allowance rules, pay transparency); review and update annually for legal and market change (links to VS-22.3 regulatory change)

CHRO/Legal prepare executive pay review (base, STI links to W3321, LTI links to W3324, benefits, perquisites) benchmarked to market, with say-on-pay and disclosure readiness; submit to Compensation Committee/Board (links to VS-36)
CHRO report compensation governance outcomes, policy compliance, and pay-equity (W3309) to the board and audit committee (links to VS-36/VS-21.1); implement board directives
